nodes.name: Office.tsx
nodes.summary: Main Office tab component. Renders a 3D office scene where each Hermes profile appears as an interactive agent. Manages agent loading via IPC (listProfiles), CEO assignment persisted in localStorage, a background status poll every 4s, and a selection sidebar showing agent details (status, model, provider, gateway). Includes the OneChat modal and a refresh button.

nodes.name: OneChatModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Full-screen modal chat UI for the Office tab. Lists agents on the left sidebar; right panel shows a chat with the selected agent. Loads/persists messages via hermesAPI.getSessionMessages and sendMessage using per-agent 'office-{id}' sessions. Supports enter/exit transitions, keyboard shortcuts, loading indicators, and optimistic message appending with error recovery.

nodes.name: Office3D.tsx
nodes.summary: Core Three.js/react-three-fiber canvas component for the 3D office. Contains the AgentsLayer (per-frame agent simulation: walking to desks or rest-room beanbags via waypoint routing through doorways), Room shell (floor, rug, walls), InteriorWalls, day/night palette driven by system clock, Lightformer-based IBL (no external HDRI), ACES tone mapping, shadow configuration, and OrbitControls. Configures troika text builder for offline CSP-safe font rendering.

nodes.name: agents.ts
nodes.summary: Maps desktop profiles (from listProfiles IPC) to OfficeAgent objects for the 3D office. Assigns deterministic accent colors via FNV-1a hash of the profile name, sets status based on gateway running state, and generates avatar profiles from seed. Exports profileToOfficeAgent and profilesToOfficeAgents.

nodes.name: profile.ts
nodes.summary: Agent avatar customization system. Defines AgentAvatarProfile type with body (skin tone), hair (style, color), clothing (top, bottom, shoes), and accessories (glasses, headset, hat, backpack). Contains all option palettes (6 skin tones, 8 hair colors, 4 hair styles, 3 top styles, 3 bottom styles, 4 shoe colors, 3 hat styles). Provides createAgentAvatarProfileFromSeed (deterministic from FNV-1a hash) and normalizeAgentAvatarProfile (validates/coerces arbitrary input).

nodes.name: constants.ts
nodes.summary: Shared numeric constants for the office simulation: canvas dimensions (1800x1800), world scale factor (0.018), walk/animation speeds, agent radius, collision parameters, east-wing room dimensions (gym, QA lab), ping-pong table physics, and various migration keys for localStorage furniture versioning.

nodes.name: geometry.ts
nodes.summary: Geometry utilities for the office canvas-to-world coordinate system. Exports toWorld (canvas coords to Three.js world), snap (grid snapping), nextUid, normalizeDegrees, ITEM_FOOTPRINT (size lookup for 50+ furniture types), ITEM_METADATA (nav-blocking flags per type), getItemBaseSize, getItemRotationRadians, getItemBounds, and createWallItem.

nodes.name: types.ts
nodes.summary: Core type definitions for the office 3D system. Defines OfficeAgent (id, name, status, color, avatar, position), RenderAgent (extends SceneActor with simulation state: position, path, facing, walk speed, collision, ping-pong, booth stages, workout), JanitorActor, FurnitureItem, FurnitureSeed, CanvasPoint, FacingPoint, and various route types (ServerRoom, QaLab, Gym, PhoneBooth, SmsBooth).

nodes.name: layout.ts
nodes.summary: Office floor layout definition in canvas space (0-1800). Defines the work-area/rest-room partition (DIVIDER_X=1180), interior wall segments with doorway gap, employee desk grid (5 columns), CEO executive desk position, buildWorkstations function (assigns desks to agents, CEO gets separate executive desk), REST_SEATS (6 beanbag positions), REST_FURNITURE (beanbags, couch, pantry, planters), and EXECUTIVE_DECOR (couch, flanking planters).

nodes.name: RiggedCharacter.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders a rigged GLB character model (biz_man.glb or man.glb) for an agent. Uses SkeletonUtils.clone for per-instance copies, auto-scales to a standard height, applies per-instance material tinting (shirt-only when available), crossfades between idle/walk/sprint/sit animations based on agent state, and disables frustum culling on skinned meshes to prevent vanishing.

nodes.name: agents.tsx
nodes.summary: The AgentModel component: renders each agent as either a rigged GLB character or a procedural voxel avatar with detailed body parts (limbs, hair styles, clothing, accessories). Animates per-frame: walk/bounce/breathe/sit, arm swing, leg movement, facial expressions (eye blinks, mouth, brows), status dot/pulse ring, speech bubbles with markdown flattening and truncation, nameplate with dynamic width measurement via troika, and held items (ping-pong paddle, cleaning tools). The largest component in the 3D system at 1355 lines.

nodes.name: furniture.tsx
nodes.summary: Renders GLB-based furniture (desk, executive desk, chair, couch, beanbag, plant, white pot, computer monitor, pantry) via useGLTF. Converts KHR_materials_unlit to MeshStandardMaterial for PBR lighting. Provides tintedClone for per-instance color, GlbItem for canvas-to-world placement with rotation, Workstations (desk + chair + monitor per agent), ExecutiveWorkstation (larger desk + flanking plants), and FurniturePieces for arbitrary placement arrays. Preloads all GLB assets.

nodes.name: types.ts (objects)
nodes.summary: TypeScript prop interfaces for 3D object components: BasicFurnitureModelProps, InteractiveFurnitureModelProps (with selection/hover/edit state), and AgentModelProps (agent identity, appearance, callbacks, speech bubble, rigged model URL and tint).
